subject: C06
required_fixes: C06-A03-RF01 [P2] Enforce the decoded-output memory budget before allocating pixels. crates/desktop-core/src/avatar.rs:63-70 sets max_alloc=128 MiB, then calls reader.into_decoder() followed by DynamicImage::from_decoder(). In pinned image 0.25.10, into_decoder() only forwards limits to the codec; it omits the limits.reserve(decoder.total_bytes()) check present in ImageReader::decode() (src/io/image_reader_type.rs:311-322). DynamicImage::from_decoder() reaches decoder_to_vec(), which allocates the entire output buffer before calling read_image (src/io/free_functions.rs:305-317). The JPEG codec checks dimensions but does not enforce max_alloc. Thus a compressible 7000x7000 RGB8 JPEG fits the source and 8192-pixel bounds while allocating a 147,000,000-byte output buffer, already above the declared 134,217,728-byte budget; larger/high-bit-depth images can require more. The same helper processes remote avatar readback. This leaves a native memory-pressure path despite the bounded-decoding claim. Dependency source was verified byte-for-byte against the Cargo.lock-matching image crate archive. Acceptance: explicitly reserve/check decoded output bytes before DynamicImage allocation and account for the remaining decoder budget, preserving orientation and resizing. Add production-interface cases whose dimensions are within 8192 but decoded storage exceeds 128 MiB, covering chosen photos and remote readback; they must be refused before oversized allocation and before any upload. The existing huge-image test only exceeds the dimension limit and does not exercise this boundary.
optional_suggestions: Align the slow-briefing Rust fixture in crates/desktop-core/tests/academy_program/main.rs with the actual Shift inputs: shift.answer uses shiftId/order/values and shift.serve uses shiftId/order. Native C06-N06 already exercises the correct shape, so the obsolete literal inputs remain a nonblocking test improvement.

Consider exposing image loading/failure state before saying 'The photo shown is what Academy serves now.' useLearnerImage keeps the previous image while refreshing and falls back to initials on failure; qualify that copy while readback is pending or unavailable.
limitations: Independently verified all four supplied fingerprints, the 308-entry source inventory, 96 referenced packet artifacts, source-bound run/log/artifact hashes, the passing C05 predecessor receipt and pinned Academy 7e8dcc7916a5a6d503415cf615246694f00e6629 tree.
